mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses risk-free discount rates and increases equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 2200) and retail sales (RSAFS < 350000) indicate weakening consumer demand that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 2200 and RSAFS < 350000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 115.0) during late-cycle expansion regimes signals reduced industrial output and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 115.0 and regime is late-cycle expansion (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% YoY) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth > 0.5% YoY (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation that triggers Federal Reserve monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS < 132000) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicate labor market stress that reduces consumer spending and triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 132000 and UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts increase above 2200 during housing market recovery regimes signals renewed construction activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 2200 and regime is housing market recovery (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
